About

I build practical software, from the Python backend to the interface people use, and I am focused on bringing AI into cybersecurity.

I am the founder of MellowTech (Pty) Ltd, an early-stage company creating cybersecurity and software solutions. I design, build, test and deploy the platform myself, which has given me hands-on experience across the whole development cycle. I am also studying towards a Bachelor of Mathematics and Science at the University of Pretoria, and I am looking to grow as an AI and software engineer.

Selected work

MellowTech Cybersecurity Platform

An AI-powered platform for security monitoring, device management and digital protection. I built the Python backend, the web interface, the SQLite data layer and the authentication, and I handle testing and deployment.

Visit MellowTech
  • Device monitoring
  • Security events and system telemetry
  • AI-assisted security features
  • Full-stack: Python, JavaScript, SQLite

MellowTech Security Operations Suite

A modular suite of security tools inside the MellowTech platform, covering threat intelligence, automation, incident response and AI assistance. Modules are released in stages, starting with the core tools and moving on to premium services.

See the platform
  • Now available: Threat Intelligence, Security Automation and Orchestration (SOAR)
  • Access-controlled: AI Assistant, Autopilot, Incident Response
  • In development: Digital Forensics, Security Awareness, Dark Web and Credential Monitoring, Malware Analysis
  • Premium, coming later: Fraud Detection and Prevention, Managed Detection and Response, Cloud Security Posture Management, Privileged Access Management
